note: Catalogue capture for the held tier-4 Thales Australia Bushmaster troop carrier brochure. The registry marks primary_held true; the held bytes are the Thales brochure from the warwheels.net mirror. The brochure publishes identity, the kerb and gross vehicle masses, the overall length, width and height, the track, the wheelbase, the approach, departure and ramp-over angles, the ground clearance under the hull, the 4x4 configuration, the Caterpillar 3126E engine and its rating and torque, the ZF transmission gear count, the Michelin tyre fitment, the fording depth, the governed speed and the maximum road range. Every value is grade claimed, which is the manufacturer tier. The brochure publishes no payload, no net power basis and no transmission-type word, so those fields are absent.

curb_weight_kg.state: kerb mass published as 11,400 kg; the brochure states no crew or fuel load
